name: firstupcjax-admins-fupcj
description: Private FirstUPCJax scheduling and official notification tools hosted on FUPCJ Server, with invited Vision accounts.

interface.longDescription: Resolve volunteers, review service plans, schedule people, and request official Planning Center Scheduling Emails. Access is controlled by the church's Vision invite list. Requires the configured FUPCJ Server and a Planning Center browser session for email dispatch.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me schedule volunteers and send their Planning Center Scheduling Emails.
